mn51:0.1: suttantapiṭake majjhimanikāyo majjhimapaṇṇāsako namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
mn51:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
mn51:1.3: atha kho pesso ca hatthārohaputto kandarako ca paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā pesso hatthārohaputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn51:1.4: kandarako pana paribbājako bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn51:1.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho kandarako paribbājako tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn51:2.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
mn51:2.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā gotamena sammā bhikkhusaṅgho paṭipādito:
mn51:2.3: yepi te bho gotama ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto etaparamaṃyeva sammā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭipādesuṃ
mn51:2.4: seyyathāpi etarahi bhotā gotamena sammā bhikkhusaṅgho paṭipādito.
mn51:2.5: yepi te bho gotama bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto etaparamaṃyeva sammā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭipādessanti
mn51:2.6: seyyathāpi etarahi bhotā gotamena sammā bhikkhusaṅgho paṭipāditoti.
mn51:3.2: yepi te kandaraka ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto etaparamaṃyeva sammā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭipādesuṃ
mn51:3.3: seyyathāpi etarahi mayā sammā bhikkhusaṅgho paṭipādito.
mn51:3.4: yepi te kandaraka bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tepi bhagavanto etaparamaṃyeva sammā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭipādessanti
mn51:3.5: seyyathāpi etarahi mayā sammā bhikkhusaṅgho paṭipādito.
mn51:3.6: santi hi kandaraka bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā.
mn51:3.7: santi pana kandaraka bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sekhā santatasīlā santatavuttino nipakā nipakavuttino.
mn51:3.10: idha kandaraka bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:3.11: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:3.12: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:3.13: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassa’nti.
mn51:4.1: evaṃ vutte pesso hatthārohaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn51:4.3: yāva supaññattā cime bhante bhagavatā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
mn51:4.4: mayampi hi bhante gihī odātavasanā kālena kālaṃ imesu catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supaṭṭhitacittā viharāma.
mn51:4.5: idha mayaṃ bhante kāye kāyānupassino viharāma, ātāpino sampajānā satimanto vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:4.6: vedanāsu vedanānupassino viharāma ātāpino sampajānā satimanto vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:4.7: citte cittānupassino viharāma ātāpino sampajānā satimanto vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
mn51:4.8: dhammesu dhammānupassino viharāma ātāpino sampajānā satimanto vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
mn51:4.10: yāvañcidaṃ bhante bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃmanussakasaṭe evaṃmanussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hitāhitaṃ jānāti.
mn51:4.13: ahaṃ hi bhante pahomi hatthidammaṃ sāretuṃ
mn51:4.14: yāvatakena antarena campaṃ gatāgataṃ karissati sabbāni tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni vaṅkeyyāni jimheyyāni pātukarissati.
mn51:4.15: amhākaṃ pana bhante dāsāti vā pessāti vā kamma karāti vā aññathā va kāyena samudācaranti, aññathāva vācāya samudācaranti, aññathā va nesaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
mn51:4.17: yāvañcidaṃ bhante bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃ manussakasaṭe evaṃ manussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hitāhitaṃ jānāti.
mn51:4.19: uttānakaṃ hetaṃ bhante yadidaṃ pasavo ti.
mn51:5.4: cattārome pessa puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ,
mn51:5.6: idha pessa ekacco puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:5.7: idha pana pessa ekacco puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:5.8: idha pana pessa ekacco puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:5.9: idha pana pessa ekacco puggalo nevattantapo hoti nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto,
mn51:5.10: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn51:5.11: imesaṃ pessa catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī’ti.
mn51:5.12: yvāyaṃ bhante puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayaṃ me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:5.13: yopāyaṃ bhante puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayampi me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:5.14: yopāyaṃ bhante puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayampi me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:5.15: yo ca kho ayaṃ puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn51:6.1: kasmā pana te pessa ime tayo puggalā cittaṃ nārādhentī’ti.
mn51:6.2: yvāyaṃ bhante puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so attānaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti, paritāpeti.
mn51:6.3: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:6.4: yopāyaṃ bhante puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so paraṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti, paritāpeti.
mn51:6.5: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:6.6: yopāyaṃ bhante puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so attānañca parañca sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti, paritāpeti.
mn51:6.7: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn51:6.8: yo ca kho ayaṃ bhante puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn51:6.9: so attānaṃ ca parañca sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ neva ātāpeti, na paritāpeti.
mn51:6.10: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ ārādheti.
mn51:6.11: handa ca dāni mayaṃ bhante gacchāma
mn51:6.14: atha kho pesso hatthārohaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn51:7.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante pesse hatthārohaputte bhikkhū āmantesi.
mn51:7.4: sace bhikkhave pesso hatthārohaputto muhuttaṃ nisīdeyya yāvassāhaṃ ime cattāro puggale vitthārena vibhajāmi. mahatā atthena saññutto agamissa.
mn51:7.5: api ca bhikkhave ettāvatāpi pesso hatthārohaputto mahatā atthena saññutto’ti.
mn51:7.6: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo,
mn51:7.7: yaṃ bhagavā ime cattāro puggale vitthārena vibhajeyya, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī’ti.
mn51:7.8: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī’ti.
mn51:7.9: evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn51:8.1: katamo ca bhikkhave puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo acelako hoti muttācāro, hatthāpalekhano, na ehibhaddantiko, na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko, nābhihaṭaṃ, na uddissa kaṭaṃ, na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
mn51:8.2: so na kumbhimukhā patigaṇhāti. na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāti. na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ, na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ, na merayaṃ, na thusodakaṃ pibati..
mn51:8.3: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko …pe… sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko.
mn51:8.4: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhipi dattīhi yāpeti, …pe… sattahipi dattīhi yāpeti,
mn51:8.5: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvīhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti …pe… sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn51:8.6: so sākabhakkho vā hoti. sāmākabhakkho vā hoti. nīvārabhakkho vā hoti. daddulabhakkho vā hoti. haṭabhakkho vā hoti. kaṇabhakkho vā hoti. ācāmabhakkho vā hoti. piññākabhakkho vā hoti. tiṇabhakkho vā hoti. gomayabhakkho vā hoti. vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
mn51:8.7: so sāṇānipi dhāreti. masāṇānipi dhāreti. chavadussānipi dhāreti. paṃsukūlānipi dhāreti. tirīṭānipi dhāreti. ajinānimpi dhāreti. ajinakkhipampi dhāreti. kusacīrampi dhāreti. vākacīrampi dhāreti. phalakacīrampi dhāreti. kesakambalampi dhāreti. vāḷakambalampi dhāreti. ulūkapakkhampi dhāreti.
mn51:8.13: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn51:8.14: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:9.1: katamo ca bhikkhave puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto:
mn51:9.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti, sūkariko sākuntiko māgaviko ḷuddo macchaghātako coro coraghātako bandhanāgāriko, ye vā panaññepi keci kurūrakammantā,
mn51:9.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:10.1: katamo ca bhikkhave puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto:
mn51:10.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo rājā vā hoti khattiyo muddhābhisitto, brāhmaṇo vā mahāsāḷo,
mn51:10.3: so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santhāgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kharājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā migavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍūvamāno santhāgāraṃ pavisati saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.
mn51:10.4: so tattha anantarahitāya bhūmiyā haritupattāya seyyaṃ kappeti,
mn51:10.5: ekissā gāviyā sarūpavacchāya yaṃ ekasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena rājā yāpeti. yaṃ dutiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena mahesī yāpeti. yaṃ tatiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena brāhmaṇo purohito yāpeti. yaṃ catutthasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena aggiṃ juhanti. avasesena vacchako yāpeti.
mn51:10.7: ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettikā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā rukkhā chijjantu yūpatthāya, ettakā dabbhā lūyantu barihisatthāyāti.
mn51:10.8: yepissa te honti dāsāti vā pessāti vā kammakarāti vā, tepi daṇḍatajjitā bhayatajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti.
mn51:10.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn51:11.1: katamo ca bhikkhave puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati:
mn51:12.1: idha bhikkhave tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn51:12.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn51:12.3: so dhammaṃ deseti: ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn51:13.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
mn51:13.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
mn51:13.3: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn51:13.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn51:13.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti .
mn51:13.7: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya, appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
mn51:14.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn51:14.2: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
mn51:14.3: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti, ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn51:14.4: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn51:14.5: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā, samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn51:14.6: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn51:14.7: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn51:15.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati, samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn51:15.2: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti, sapattabhārova ḍeti.
mn51:15.3: evameva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. yena yeneva pakkamati, samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn51:15.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn51:16.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī,
mn51:16.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn51:16.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn51:16.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn51:16.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn51:17.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
mn51:18.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato,
mn51:18.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati. araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn51:19.1: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn51:19.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn51:19.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī. byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn51:19.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno. thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn51:19.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn51:19.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn51:20.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe,
mn51:20.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn51:21.1: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn51:22.1: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati. sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn51:23.1: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn51:24.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn51:24.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo, tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsatimpi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn51:25.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn51:25.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne, hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti. ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn51:26.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn51:26.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn51:27.1: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn51:27.2: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn51:27.4: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn51:28.1: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto,
mn51:28.2: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharatī’ti.
mn51:28.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
